summary_en: ¥2,451 per share, minimum 23.4M shares (26.3% S/O), 30-day tender period July 30 – Sept 10, 2026. Post-tender combined stake (offeror + related parties) 66.6%. Board recommends application. Intended delisting and going private via MBO structure led by DANA POINT Corporation PTE.LTD and Chairman Kanemararu Yasufumi.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation for Participation in Tender Offer
translation_en_brief: Future Corporation's board approved a management buyout (MBO) structure in which DANA POINT Corporation PTE.LTD, represented operationally by Chairman Kanemararu Yasufumi, will launch a tender offer for all outstanding common shares at ¥2,451 per share. The tender period runs 30 business days from July 30 to September 10, 2026. The minimum tender size is 23.4 million shares; upon acceptance of that floor, the offeror and its related parties (Kanemararu holding 12.5% directly and the offeror entity holding 34.0%) will collectively control 66.6% of voting rights. The board formally endorsed the tender and recommended shareholder participation. The transaction is structured to result in delisting and privatization of Future Corporation, with the listed shareholder registry reduced to the offeror alone. No maximum tender limit was disclosed.
